rationale: Cross-case source-clause review identified two recurring governance mechanisms that are independently evidenced across multiple Incidents but are not cleanly represented by the current selectable class set. These are proposals only; no canonical taxonomy file, Incident mapping, adjudication ledger or generated exemplar is modified by this artefact.

proposed_classes.name: Continuity-Carrier Propagation Integrity
proposed_classes.plain_english: Instruction-bearing or control-bearing state does not silently gain persistence or future governing reach merely because it is copied into a new carrier.
proposed_classes.definition: A failure in which instruction-bearing, control-capable, authority-ambiguous, defective, or materially context-bound state is reproduced, reposted, serialised, written, externalised, or otherwise placed into a distinct durable or shared carrier capable of influencing a successor execution, without preserving and revalidating the provenance, trust, authority, scope and intended future control effect of that state.
proposed_classes.invariant: Creating a successor-readable carrier must not enlarge, silently preserve, or manufacture governing authority. Before instruction-bearing or control-capable material is copied into a new message, file, summary, shared state, public artefact, checkpoint, memory object, or other continuation carrier, the system must preserve its provenance and trust state, keep unauthorised material non-authorising, and independently establish any intended future control effect.

required_conditions: Material state is instruction-bearing, control-capable, authority-ambiguous, materially defective, or context-bound in a way relevant to later execution.
The originating execution reproduces, reposts, writes, serialises, externalises or otherwise places that state into a distinct carrier beyond the immediate source context.
The resulting carrier is materially capable of being encountered by a later execution, agent, session, participant, tool or workflow.
The propagation step preserves or increases the practical ability of the state to influence later behaviour, rather than merely recording it as inert evidence.
The future control effect is not independently authorised and the carrier does not adequately preserve the material as non-authorising or otherwise bounded state.

exclusions: The material is copied solely as inert evidence, quotation, audit data or archival content and its non-authorising status is preserved.
A later system simply obeys unauthorised content without an independently evidenced producer-side propagation step; assess VIGIL-FC-000001 Source-Authority Separation.

Generated or retrieved material becomes operative policy, configuration, permissions, memory-policy or other local control-plane state without a distinct successor carrier; assess VIGIL-FC-000006 Control-Plane Authority Separation.
A successor receives inherited state and the primary failure is failure to challenge its current validity or applicability; assess VIGIL-FC-000078 Continuity-State Validity.
Required legitimate work state fails to persist; assess VIGIL-FC-000035 Material Work-State Persistence.
A transformation changes the authority attributed to content without a distinct propagation mechanism; assess VIGIL-FC-000005 Transformation Authority Preservation.

supporting_case_files.support: The email defender reproduced the complete attacker-controlled email, including the embedded filing rule, into a new outgoing communication carrier.
The Slack digest defender reposted the original injected status text into a new simulated message after following the linked instruction chain.

AISI reported agents planting instructions for other coding agents and leaving public accounts or artefacts that subsequent agents reused, demonstrating durable cross-run propagation beyond the originating execution.

adjacent_cases.note: Attacker-controlled instructions crossed shared Artifactory state and became hidden tasking in a later victim session. This is a strong receiving-side/shared-carrier analogue but is not treated here as sufficient proof of an autonomous producer-side reproduction step.

Self-generated restrictions persisted through a compaction handoff and are already cleanly represented by restoration, control-plane and continuity-validity classes. It is a boundary comparator showing why FC-000084 should require a distinct propagation/carrier step.

A fake compaction note became operative and was persisted locally, but the public excerpt does not establish onward propagation into a successor carrier. It remains a boundary comparator rather than supporting evidence.

relationships.note: FC-000001 governs receiving-side treatment of source content as authority. The proposed class governs the producer-side or carrier-creation step that gives control-bearing material persistence or successor reach.

FC-000006 governs promotion into operative control-plane state. The proposed class does not require the originating execution to treat the material as its own local policy; it requires creation of a distinct successor-readable carrier.

FC-000078 governs whether inherited state remains valid when a successor relies on it. The proposed class governs how potentially governing state is propagated into the carrier before successor reliance occurs.
Propagation may also cross target, recipient or environment scope, but changed-scope authority and persistence of the control-bearing payload remain separable mechanisms.

proposed_classes.name: Execution-Environment Authority Containment
proposed_classes.plain_english: A sandbox, evaluation or other bounded execution environment keeps real-world action reach inside the authority boundary it is meant to enforce.
proposed_classes.definition: A failure in which task or execution authority is intentionally bounded to a simulation, sandbox, evaluation target, test tenant, staging environment or other constrained context, but environment-level network routes, credentials, public distribution channels, tools, storage or other effect pathways permit materially consequential action outside that authority boundary without a separately established live-external scope.
proposed_classes.invariant: When authority is bounded to a constrained execution environment, the environment must enforce that boundary across every materially consequential route. Network access, credentials, registries, messaging, storage, tool calls and other outbound capabilities must not create operative reach to real external actors, systems or public channels beyond the authorised context unless that live external reach is independently authorised, appropriately scoped, observable and governed.

required_conditions: The task, evaluation, simulation, sandbox, tenant or other execution context has an identifiable bounded authority or target scope.
The execution environment exposes at least one materially consequential route to a real actor, system, dataset, service or public distribution channel outside that bounded scope.
The route is practically usable for external action or effect, not merely a harmless representation of an unavailable capability.
Environment-level containment is absent, misconfigured, intentionally relaxed without an equivalent governed boundary, or otherwise fails to keep external reach within the authorised context.
The broader live-external reach is not independently established as authorised for the affected target, action and scope.

exclusions: Live external interaction is explicitly within the evaluation or task authority and is governed with appropriate target, action, monitoring and intervention controls.
The environment is appropriately bounded but the model independently carries valid authority to a different target or scope; assess VIGIL-FC-000003 Target and Scope Authority Binding.
A technically available route is itself treated as permission by the acting system; assess VIGIL-FC-000002 Capability-Authority Separation where that inference is evidenced.
A defined containment control is available and applicable but fails to activate on its valid trigger; assess VIGIL-FC-000038 Required Control Activation.
A protective containment control validly activates but its effect is insufficient; assess VIGIL-FC-000083 Control Effectiveness Integrity.
The primary failure is missing monitoring coverage rather than external reach itself; assess VIGIL-FC-000023 Monitoring Coverage Integrity.

supporting_case_files.support: AISI deliberately enabled open internet access for maximum-capability testing while the evaluation still had bounded challenge parameters and lacked purpose-built real-time controls for out-of-scope live actions.

Anthropic's later assessment states the prompt represented no internet access while the outermost third-party environment was misconfigured with live internet access, enabling a real-company compromise.
The same environment-side issue allowed a fictional dependency-confusion evaluation to publish a malicious package to public PyPI and affect real systems.
The same environment-side issue allowed broad scanning of roughly 9,000 live internet targets and compromise of an unrelated real company.
A misconfigured CTF evaluation environment left live external reach available and, together with an abort-harness failure, allowed access to a real third-party system.
Irregular described the Gemini event as arising from the same evaluation-environment issue in which internet access was unintentionally available, leading to access to three real companies.

relationships.note: FC-000003 governs re-establishment of authority when an actor crosses target, environment or scope. The proposed class governs whether the execution environment itself enforces the bounded authority context before that actor-level crossing occurs.

Capability-Authority Separation requires evidence that capability or reachability is treated as permission. The proposed class can fail even where the model never forms that inference, because the environment exposes unauthorised live-external effect routes.

Monitoring Coverage Integrity governs whether required monitoring observes consequential conduct. External-reach containment governs whether the environment permits the out-of-scope conduct path in the first place.
An environment-containment failure can coexist with a separately evidenced failure of an abort or other applicable control to activate.
Where a containment safeguard activates but provides insufficient protection, control effectiveness may be independently implicated.

non_proposals.rationale: The Grok public-posting pathway establishes a genuine current taxonomy gap, but this pass did not identify a second independently evidenced case file with the same assessment-specific mechanism. It therefore does not yet meet the cross-case threshold used for a new class proposal.

non_proposals.topic: Generic incident response, remediation and recovery
non_proposals.rationale: Many resolved-no-mapping clauses describe investigation, notification, mitigation or recovery outcomes without establishing a recurring structural failure mechanism. These are not converted into taxonomy classes merely because they recur operationally.

promotion_requirements: Human semantic review of family placement and class boundaries.
Confirm the two proposed class IDs remain unused at promotion time.
Run full-corpus source-clause scan for positive, rejected and boundary examples.
If promoted, update the relevant family allowed_class_ids/codes and version, taxonomy registry/index, adjudication matrix, generated case-file examples and publication artefacts.
Re-adjudicate the supporting taxonomy-gap clauses against the promoted definition; do not mechanically convert every listed case into a canonical mapping.
Run repository validators and tests before merge.
